summary: Enhance your safety skills with our comprehensive First Aid and Fire Extinguisher Training. Be prepared for emergencies and protect those around you.
lede: Fire extinguisher training covers safe extinguisher selection and use alongside first aid for workplace emergencies. Designed for safety staff, facilities coordinators, supervisors and team leaders expected to respond, it develops scene assessment, CPR and AED response, wound and burn care, and matching fire classes to extinguisher types, with practice in evacuation coordination and incident records.
audienceIntro: This course is built for people who are expected to act first when a medical emergency or small fire occurs, then document and escalate the event correctly. It is also useful for teams that support workplace safety systems, emergency drills, and equipment checks across offices, plants, warehouses, campuses, and service environments. Safety Officers who coordinate workplace first aid readiness and extinguisher drills. Facilities Coordinators who maintain emergency equipment, signage, and response records. Operations Supervisors who lead staff during medical and fire incidents. Team Leaders who initiate immediate response and evacuation steps. Emergency Wardens who guide muster points and casualty handover. HSE Specialists who track incident logs and drill compliance. Occupational Health Practitioners who support first-response procedures on site. Site Managers who oversee emergency action plans and readiness reviews. Warehouse Supervisors who manage injury response and fire-risk controls. Frontline Administrators who maintain emergency contacts and response registers.
modules: First Aid and Fire Safety Foundations
prerequisites: Participants need a willingness to engage in practical drills, follow instructor-led safety instructions, and complete scenario-based exercises. A notebook, pen, and access to a laptop or tablet for digital checklists are helpful; no programming, coding, or specialist software installation is required.
